config.label: AWS profile used when a tool call omits `profile`
config.description: AWS profile used when a tool call omits `profile`. Any profile your aws CLI can use (SSO, credential_process, role chaining, static keys). Unset: AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE, then `default`.

config.label: Region used when a tool call omits `region`
config.description: Region used when a tool call omits `region`. Unset: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, then us-east-1 (a profile's own region setting is not read).
